item.title: Citi's Gupte on IPO Outlook
item.description: Aloke Gupte, Global Co-Head of Equity Capital Markets at Citi, speaks on "Bloomberg The China Show" after his bank claimed top spot for global IPO underwriters for the year through September. (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: Belgian Government Facing Push to Sell 5.7% BNP Paribas Stake
item.description: Belgium is ramping up efforts to divest from stakes it amassed in banks during the global financial crisis, with some in the government pushing to prioritize the sale of its 5.7% stake in BNP Paribas SA.

item.title: Wheat Hits 11-Week Low as Risk Premiums Ease on Ukraine Talks
item.description: Wheat futures hit the lowest since Aug. 5 as traders wound back risk premiums after US President Donald Trump increased pressure on Ukraine to strike a peace agreement with Russia.
